lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill region. The spots are organized into at least four parallel horizontal rows. The inter-centroid distance between spots in the dorsal-most row is approximately double that of the rows situated immediately ventral to it.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs at near 90-degree angles, creating a rectilinear grid where the blobs serve as primary nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank. It is defined by a sharp vertical gradient transition, with higher luminance on the upper edge and distinct shadowing on the lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregular, high-luminance (white) patch is visible on the lower posterior flank, posterior to the pelvic region, suggesting a significant area of depigmented scar tissue or physical trauma.
